{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-id-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"9d61928e24449b6f0cf5990cfce5a078fe1f02895b39458cd295c33935f07ad1","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-id-class-d:lineage:6","source_registry_sha256":"9c432577e712960022ff656d6738a091319c6e5e4dcbdcf9429cd450e142e543","source_liveness_sha256":"eee60602368bd429216c9c2833be0be6ed9e505e5c5accebaefb9d2b9a847475"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Identity, residency and applicant requirements","heading":"C2 — Identity, residency and applicant requirements","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Identity, residency and applicant requirements

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A23
A foreign national may substitute a foreign passport for the certified United States birth certificate. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A23
For a foreign national’s identity, the handbook requires a valid foreign passport and acceptable lawful-presence evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A23
Secondary identity documents cannot establish identity on their own. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A23
A secondary identity document must show the name and enough information to support part or all of the primary identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A23
A certified court name-change record is listed as a secondary identity document. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A23
A certified marriage record meeting Idaho standards needs the seal and recorded document number to serve as the listed secondary evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A23
A certified divorce record from a court or state vital-records office is listed as secondary identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A23
Guardianship or custody records must be notarized or court-certified to qualify as the listed secondary evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A23
Military discharge papers are listed as secondary identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A23
Every submitted document must be acceptable to both ITD and the county driver’s license office. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A24
The Social Security Administration’s online verification system must verify the applicant’s Social Security number. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A24
An Idaho license or identification card does not display the holder’s Social Security number. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A24
An applicant must live within Idaho to receive an Idaho license or identification card. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A24
Residency evidence must show a physical address and may include a lease, utility bill, employment record or school-enrollment record. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A24
The documents used as Idaho residency evidence must be dated within one year. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A24
A person without lawful presence in the United States is ineligible for an Idaho license or identification card. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R17 | anchor: A24
An issuance or renewal may require lawful-presence evidence when citizenship proof was never provided or ITD has no record of it. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R18 | anchor: A24
Listed lawful-presence evidence includes an original certified United States birth certificate, a valid United States passport, a birth-abroad certificate or an original naturalization or citizenship certificate. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R19 | anchor: A24
A permanent resident card, resident-alien card or employment authorization card is listed among lawful-presence evidence. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R20 | anchor: A24
A valid foreign passport together with the arrival-departure record is listed among lawful-presence evidence. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R21 | anchor: A25
For someone who is neither a citizen nor permanent legal resident, license validity ends at the documented lawful-stay end date or after four years, whichever comes first. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R22 | anchor: A25
When Homeland Security documents have no expiration date, the license for a noncitizen who is not a permanent legal resident expires one year after issuance. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R23 | anchor: A25
A visual or medical condition affecting driving may require a physician’s statement that the applicant can drive safely. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R24 | anchor: A25
After eye surgery improves vision, a physician’s note may support removal of a license restriction. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R25 | anchor: A25
An applicant younger than seventeen must document both approved driver training completion and completion of supervised instruction requirements. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R26 | anchor: A26
A license applicant younger than eighteen needs a parent or legal guardian to consent and assume legal responsibility for the applicant’s driving. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R27 | anchor: A26
A liability signer other than a birth-certificate parent must document legal authority to consent. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R28 | anchor: A26
The liability signer’s identity must be verified. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R29 | anchor: A26
A signer whose name differs from the birth-certificate name may need additional documents establishing the relationship. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R30 | anchor: A26
An absent liability signer must give another person signing authority through a power-of-attorney form. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R31 | anchor: A26
Before the applicant turns eighteen, the liability signer can withdraw consent at any time and the department will cancel the driving credential. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R32 | anchor: A26
A married applicant’s spouse may act as liability signer if the spouse is at least eighteen. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R33 | anchor: A26
An applicant younger than eighteen must show acceptable evidence of attendance and enrollment in, or graduation from, a recognized high school or equivalent program. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R34 | anchor: A26
A compliance slip, high school diploma or general-education completion certificate may document school compliance. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R35 | anchor: A26
The parent or guardian signing liability consent must also affirm compliance with Idaho’s school-attendance provisions. [A26]
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R36 | anchor: A27
A Star Card application needs identity, photograph and lawful-presence evidence. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R37 | anchor: A27
A Star Card applicant needs name-change evidence when the legal name has changed. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R38 | anchor: A27
A Star Card applicant’s Social Security number is verified with the Social Security Administration. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R39 | anchor: A27
A Star Card application requires two proofs showing an Idaho physical residence address. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R40 | anchor: A27
The donor designation may be requested beginning at age fifteen. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R41 | anchor: A27
A donor designation communicates the holder’s wish to donate organs or tissue after death. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R42 | anchor: A27
A donor applicant younger than eighteen needs consent from a parent or adult guardian. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R43 | anchor: A27
For a veteran designation, the handbook lists military discharge documentation indicating honorable discharge. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0027]
